g.text: C. Complete task includes actual tests, saving, repair and final suffix work
Task ms; incremental control skips only unchanged compilation; tests still execute
First-artifact versus repeated execution is measured; the responsible kernel / security subsystem is not sampled.
Incremental recipe is an explicit deployment benchmark, not automatic caching or rewriting of user tool commands.
